prices.what: Student fare (junior high to university/vocational), with student ID

group.text: Groups of 10 or more: reservations by fax only; under 10 can sometimes book on the web (prepaid).
group.quote: 10名様以上に限り、FAXにて受け付けております。

booking.text: Reservations accepted from 3 months ahead; changes or cancellations until 17:00 the day before. Boarding tickets are issued on the day only.
booking.quote: ※ご変更やお取消しは、前日17時まで承ります。

notes.text: Boarding tickets are sold on the day only.
notes.quote: ※乗船券の発券は「 当日のみ 」です。

notes.text: Operating hours are not stated on the official page; first and last boat times can change. Operator phone for day-of status.
notes.quote: ※始発便と最終便の時間が変更となる場合があります。

notes.text: Operator line for day-of status: Ippon Matsu Kaiun, 06-6441-0532, 9:00-18:00.
Weather, river works or events can cause cancellation without notice.
notes.quote: ※気象・海象・潮位等により運休となる場合があります。

notes.text: The operator's year-end notice found is for 2025-26 only; no 2026-27 year-end notice was found.
notes.quote: 【とんぼりリバークルーズ】2025年～2026年の 年末年始につきまして
